title: dungdra/combat.py move(): crawling's doubled cost is still chosen by name (`mode == "crawl"`). Give MoveMode a field such as `crawling: bool` (or an extra-cost flag) and set it on the "crawl" entry of MOVE_MODES, so the crawl cost comes from that table like the Prone check now does.

history.summary: Gave MoveMode a `crawling: bool = False` field and set it on the "crawl" entry of MOVE_MODES. move() now applies crawling's doubled cost via `spec.crawling` instead of checking `mode == "crawl"`, so the crawl cost comes from the table, like the Prone check. Behaviour is unchanged. Added unit tests: only the crawl entry is flagged as crawling, and crawling while not Prone costs double while walking doesn't. Ruff, unit tests (401 passed), the Prone/crawl glossary tests and dev-gate all pass. No SRD tag was added: GLOSS.crawling has no stage-A analysis to take a clause number from, and the existing GLOSS.prone#1 tag still covers the Prone part.
